info.name: Booking.com Car Rentals Accommodations OTA Reservations API

items.docs: Processes reservation notifications following the OTA OTA_HotelResNotif specification. Used for receiving and confirming new reservations through the OpenTravel Alliance standard format.
Processes reservation modification notifications following the OTA OTA_HotelResModifyNotif specification. Used for receiving and confirming changes to existing reservations.
